authority: Owner explicitly approved Bitter Winter, specified exceptions, protected home field and standard difficulty durations.

field.name: Bitter Winter
field.activation: battle start without action or PP
field.effect: Non-Ice Pokemon restore 50% less HP from battle healing effects; Ice-type Pokemon retain normal healing.
field.application: Apply once to positive intended healing before missing-HP cap; round down, minimum 1 HP for otherwise successful positive healing. Never create healing from zero or bypass healing prevention.
included: held items and permitted bag healing items
ability healing including switching abilities and absorption
ally healing based on recipient type
exceptions: reviving fainted Pokemon if otherwise allowed
direct HP equalization such as Pain Split
field.weather: Separate from weather; intended coexistence with normal weather and terrain. Weather replacement cannot clear Bitter Winter.
